WASHINGTON, Aug 26 (Reuters) - The ​United States on Wednesday ‌imposed sanctions on the Palestine Action group, designating it a Specially Designated ​Global Terrorist, according ​to a notice posted on ⁠a Treasury Department website.
The United ​Kingdom previously banned Palestine ​Action as a terrorist organization.
Palestine Action had increasingly targeted Israel‑linked ​defense companies in Britain ​with a particular focus on Israel's ‌largest ⁠defense firm Elbit Systems (ESLT.TA)
